text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower wasn't feeling well,
so I decided to let her rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm sorry for causing trouble.
I'll get back in shape right away, so please wait for me.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are! Senpai! I've been looking for you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Eh, um... what do you mean by senpai...?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Flower-senpai,
you're going to watch my training today, right!
I've been looking forward to this forever!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Senpai...
...I'm... a senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: *pant* *pant*... How was it? My running?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... your final spurt
was really great.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I just thought the pacing in the middle
was a little inconsistent, though.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see...!
I'm learning so much!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...U-Um! If you're free,
could you help me study after this...!?"

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey! You promised to watch
my training right after this!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Then after that is totally fine! Come on, Senpai, please!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course.
You can leave something like that to me!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, please calm down first. I'll help you one by one!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Are you sure, Senpai?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally.
After all, I am everyone's—"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Because I'm your "senpai"!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Was that just... a dream?
But that smile—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "Someday, to make that vision a reality...! I've got to do my best!"

After having a good dream, Nishino Flower
was back in top shape, both in mind and body.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: That's so not fair! I want you to look over my studies after training too!

text_block_list.name: Juniors
text_block_list.text:
—Why can't we just do it tomorrow?!
—You're the one who should wait until tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: U-Um! T-That fight is—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh... A dream...?
What a relief, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I suppose I am still very far
from being a reliable senior...
Nishino Flower had a bad dream and couldn't seem to get back into top form.
